claimText: Should this same transparency standard apply to a teacher's use of AI in the classroom, even when disclosure might undermine the pedagogical value of the exercise itself?".

meta.questionText: The EU AI Act mandates that individuals be informed when interacting with an AI system or consuming AI-generated content. Should this same transparency standard apply to a teacher's use of AI in the classroom, even when disclosure might undermine the pedagogical value of the exercise itself?
